mapper.select: select id , product_category_id as productCategoryId , name , price , image_url as imageUrl , delete_flag as deleteFlag from product order by id

select product.id product_id , product.product_category_id , product.name product_name , product.price product_price , product.image_url product_image_url , product.delete_flag product_delete_flag , product_category.name product_category_name from product inner join product_category on product.product_category_id = product_category.id order by product_id

select product.id product_id , product.product_category_id , product.name product_name , product.price product_price , product.image_url product_image_url , product.delete_flag product_delete_flag , product_category.name product_category_name from product inner join product_category on product.product_category_id = product_category.id where product.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into product (product_category_id, name, price, image_url, delete_flag) values (#{productCategoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, #{deleteFlag})
